$comment: Runtime identity authority (LLP 0175 §7.4): every claim the Ibex runtime makes about what it is derives from this file. Consumers span TS, Rust, and C++ across two load stages, so the authority is language-neutral JSON with generated bindings (identity.generated.ts, identity_generated.rs) produced by `bun packages/exact-devtools/src/scripts/generate-runtime-identity.ts`. Policy (LLP 0175 §7.2): Node-primary — versions.node is pinned to the Node release the vendored compat corpus tracks; every other key must be truthful (no v8/uv/openssl/modules masquerade; the compat harness injects fixture-fidelity keys per test, they never ship ambient). The Bun-shaped surface is opt-in via --compat=bun, which also sets versions.bun so detection stays coherent in both states.
name: ibex
